product_wide_rationale: The editing boundary governs the plugin's OpenCode registrations and the shared editing implementation. No child Domain exists yet.
summary: The tool acquires object-bound editing authority beneath the session root, refuses symlinks and unsupported confinement, publishes new targets through an atomic create-if-absent link that refuses a concurrently created destination, replaces existing targets without modifying hard-link aliases, rejects root-selection arguments, and preserves read-only and merge-safety guards.
title: Morph editing boundary
